description: Delete a previously read regular file only if its current SHA-256 hash still matches expectedHash. Paths are workspace-relative unless the user explicitly enabled unrestricted host access.

propertyDescriptions.path: Workspace-relative file path, or an absolute host path only in unrestricted mode.
propertyDescriptions.expectedHash: Full-file SHA-256 hash returned by read_file.

guidance: delete_file deletes a previously read regular file using its expected hash. Use it only when removing the whole file is necessary; never substitute a shell deletion command for this checked tool when the checked tool can perform the operation.
